Read and station-match a set of microscopy samples

Source: R/microscopy.R
load_microscopy_samples.Rd

A file that cannot be read, or whose station is not an AlgAware station, is reported in status instead of stopping the whole load.

Usage

load_microscopy_samples(
  paths,
  file_names = basename(paths),
  algaware_stations = load_algaware_stations(),
  shark_stations = load_shark_stations(verbose = FALSE)
)

Arguments

paths

Paths to Plankton Toolbox .xlsx exports.

file_names

Names to report the files under.

algaware_stations

Data frame from load_algaware_stations().

shark_stations

SHARK station register.

Value

A list with obs (one row per taxon and sample, with STATION_NAME, STATION_NAME_SHORT, COAST, visit_date, visit_id and sample_index) and status (one row per file: sample_index, file, station, date, used, reason).
